description:
Port-map §6.7 + §7.2 promise \`:aborted\` vs \`:error\` distinction; we currently produce \`:error\` in both cases. Detect caller death via the existing DOWN monitor in handle_chunk and thread an \`aborted?: true\` flag into the terminal Event.Error.

TDD:
- RED: write a test that starts a producer, receives Event.Start, kills the caller pid, and (via a listener proxy) asserts a separate observer sees Event.Error{reason: :aborted}.
- GREEN: in handle_chunk when the DOWN fires, set state.aborted? = true before returning {:halt, acc}. Then emit_done_or_error/emit_http_error branch on state.aborted? and call Decoder.error(state, "aborted by caller", :aborted).

Depends on opi-hgb.1 (cleaner state flow makes this easier).

Files: producer.ex, producer_test.exs, decoder.ex (if error/3 needs adjustment).
title: Producer: emit Event.Error reason: :aborted on caller death
